teacher_info.about_teacher: I understand how difficult and frustrating it may be for someone who learns a new language such as Arabic, therefore, my goal is to make the lesson as easy and simple as possible. I will do my best to make the learning process enjoyable and useful in order to maintain your enthusiasm, and for you to reap the fruits of your efforts quickly. I will create a friendly learning environment, encourage you to speak from the first day without pressure and together we will develop a plan that suits you and meets your needs.
teacher_info.teaching_style: I like a conversation-based class because I want you to be able to confidently use what you've learned. I will encourage you from day one to start using Arabic during our classes, without feeling any pressure. We will focus on speaking, but we will also work on grammar, keeping in mind your personal goals and needs. As for learning material, I could provide you with my own material, or we could use any other type of material you prefer. Between your sessions, I will provide you with unlimited support, you can always count on me to answer any questions you may have. Please feel free to get in touch with me before classes to tell me about your needs and expectations.

course_info.trial_description:

If you have a specific plan or topics you would like to discuss, it would be my pleasure to assist you with your plan.  And if you don't have a specific plan, I will teach you some new words, sentences, and grammar to use in everyday life.  I will make sure that by the end of the trial lesson, and in the time available, you will be able to speak some sentences in Arabic and that you are excited for the next lesson. If you are a beginner, do not worry, I will teach you the alphabet from the beginning in a fast and effective way.  You can record the lesson and refer to it as you wish, and you can count on me any time after the lesson to answer any questions you may have.

I will assist you in writing, reading, listening, and we will speak together in Arabic from day one. I will work out a plan for you that would ignite your passion for the Arabic language. pro_course_detail.description:
I think the fastest and most effective way to learn a new language is practice and shadowing. 
Together, we will talk about many different topics from daily life. I will correct your mistakes, and help you learn many new words and sentences, and how to use them in everyday life. I will help you pronounce the words correctly and together we will work on your areas of weakness to strengthen your language level. If you have certain topics or interests that you would like to discuss, it would be would my absolute pleasure to go with your plan. I want you to feel comfortable while practicing the language, and not be afraid of making mistakes. The path to mastery begins with practice, and I'm here to help you.

*Please be aware that it is not possible to cancel/reschedule the lesson less than 24 hours before the lesson time begins. That includes time zone/lesson time misunderstandings, so please check your time zone before booking.*

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Practice (Egyptian Dialect)
pro_course_detail.description:
Egypt is the most populous country in the Arab world, and so its Arabic is the most widely spoken Arabic dialect.  Egyptian Arabic is understood by almost all of the 300 million Arabic speakers in the world, thanks to the Egyptian cinema and media industry. I will teach you how to speak the Egyptian Arabic fluently, while along the way, I will point out to the differences between the Egyptian Dialect and Fusha (Modern Standard Arabic).  I will teach you many tricks and hacks to learn quicker, and yield tangible results in a shorter period of time.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Practice

In these lessons, we will talk about many topics and I will send you before the lesson many new words to look up. I will also send voice messages with the pronunciation of each word so that we can use them in the lesson to form new sentences. If you have any special topic that you would like to talk about, I will be very glad to help you. I will be available from lesson to lesson to answer any question you have and I will do my best to make sure that you are constantly developing.

*Please be aware that it is not possible to cancel/reschedule the lesson less than 24 hours before the lesson time begins. That includes time zone/lesson time misunderstandings, so please check your time zone before booking.*

pro_course_detail.title: Vocabulary and Sentences
pro_course_detail.description:
The thing about Arabic is that it's a language that has its own letters, and its mastery requires great knowledge of many words and vocabulary. The more vocabulary you acquire, the higher your level in Arabic gets. In this course, we will work together to effectively increase your share of new vocabulary. I would like to help you invest your time in the best possible way. Therefore, before each lesson I will send you a wide variety of words and how to pronounce them. During the lesson, we will work together to form many different sentences using this new vocabulary. I tried this method with many students and it worked, so I promise that you will see a noticeable difference in a short period of time.

*Please be aware that it is not possible to cancel/reschedule the lesson less than 24 hours before the lesson time begins. That includes time zone/lesson time misunderstandings, so please check your time zone before booking.*

pro_course_detail.title: Think Like an Egyptian: Egyptian Culture Immersion
pro_course_detail.description:
Egypt has a rich history and culture dating back thousands of years, starting with the Pharaonic culture, then Christianity and Islam. Egypt is among the earliest civilizations. Its culture has been affected by many other cultures and ethnic groups who either lived in or invaded the country, creating a melting pot. Egyptian cultural influence is also transmitted to the rest of the Arabic-speaking world in the Cairo dialect.
In this lesson I will teach you everything you need to know about Egyptian culture, customs, traditions and values. I will help you see the country with Egyptian eyes, and together we will watch clips from Egyptian films, listen to Egyptian songs, read Egyptian newspapers and magazines. I will make you immerse in the Egyptian culture that you might even decide to move here immediately 😉

*Please be aware that it is not possible to cancel/reschedule the lesson less than 24 hours before the lesson time begins. That includes time zone/lesson time misunderstandings, so please check your time zone before booking.*
